lines.japanese: 自分が学校へ通うようになって、改めてタカシ君の偉大さを実感することが多い。
lines.english: Now that I attended school myself, I often found myself appreciating Takashi's greatness all over again.

lines.japanese: 朝の満員電車もそのひとつ。
lines.english: The packed morning train was one example.

lines.japanese: 顔も知らないひとたちと息がかかるほど密着して、互いに押されたり潰されたり流されたり。
lines.english: Pressed close enough to feel the breath of total strangers, all of us shoving, crushing, and sweeping one another along.

lines.japanese: これを週に五回も延々くりかえすなんて、ホント皆さんご苦労さまです。自分、新参者ですが、よろしくお願いいたします。
lines.english: To everyone who endured this endlessly five days a week: thank you for your service. I'm new here, but I look forward to working with you.

lines.japanese: 「ふぅぅ……」
lines.english: “Phewww...”

lines.japanese: なんとか扉際の場所を確保して、ひんやり冷たい窓ガラスに額を──
lines.english: I somehow secured a place beside the door and lowered my forehead toward the pleasantly cold window—

lines.japanese: 「──わたあっ」
lines.english: “—whoa!”

lines.japanese: 「きゃっ」
lines.english: “Eek!”

lines.japanese: やっば、油断して隣りの子に思いっきりぶつかっちゃった！
lines.english: Oh, crap. I let my guard down and slammed right into the girl beside me!

lines.japanese: 「ごっ、ごめんなさい」
lines.english: “I-I'm sorry.”

lines.japanese: 謝りながら慌てて離れました。
lines.english: I hurriedly pulled away as I apologized.

lines.japanese: あれ？　返事してくれない。ああ、そんなに怒らせちゃいましたか。
lines.english: Huh? No answer. Ah, had I made her that angry?

lines.japanese: 見れば同じ学校の後輩さんです。日和子さんと同じ学年色だから二年生。謝る最上級生をシカトとは、なかなか強気な態度ですね。
lines.english: Looking closer, I saw she was a younger student from my school. Her year-color matched Hiyoko's, making her a second-year. Ignoring an apologetic senior took a fairly bold attitude.

lines.japanese: ま、一方的に俺が悪いんだから、とくに不満はないけどさ。
lines.english: Well, I was entirely at fault, so I had no complaint.

lines.japanese: フッと息を吹きあげて前髪を揺らしました。
lines.english: I puffed upward and sent my bangs fluttering.

lines.japanese: 正直だいぶチキンだった俺も、タカシ君と隼人君から図々しさやポジティブシンキングをもらったせいか、最近は他人から疎まれることに対してそれなりに耐性が──
lines.english: I had honestly been quite a coward, but perhaps some of Takashi and Hayato's nerve and positive thinking had rubbed off on me. Lately, I had built up a reasonable tolerance for being disliked—

lines.japanese: 「あ、あのっ」

lines.english: “Hm?”

lines.japanese: くだんの後輩さんが、揺れる満員電車の中とつぜん小さな声をあげました。
lines.english: The junior in question suddenly spoke in a small voice over the rocking of the crowded train.

lines.japanese: 流れる車窓の景色を前にしたまま、誰にとも判然としない方向へ……あ、いや、ちらっと一瞬こっち見た。
lines.english: Still facing the scenery streaming past the window, she spoke in no discernible direction... No, wait. She had glanced at me for an instant.

lines.japanese: え、俺？
lines.english: Me?

lines.japanese: 「おっ、おシさヒぶりです偶然デスネっ」
lines.english: “I-it has been a long time since seeing you! What a coincidence this is!”
...Who was she?

lines.japanese: 下級生の女子が、ドアへ押しつけられ潰れそうになりながら、俺に声をかけてきたのです。
lines.english: A younger schoolgirl, nearly crushed against the door, had spoken to me.

lines.japanese: え、どういうこと？　この子、俺……ていうかタカシ君のお友達だったの？
lines.english: What did this mean? Was she my... or rather, Takashi's friend?

lines.japanese: いや、そうじゃないはず。いまの俺はタカシ君と一緒になったことで、彼の記憶や経験をある程度引きつがせてもらっている。
lines.english: No, she couldn't be. By becoming one with Takashi, I had inherited some portion of his memories and experiences.

lines.japanese: そんな俺が、知らない相手──
lines.english: Yet I didn't know her—

lines.japanese: ──つまり、過去なんらかの接触があったにしても、タカシ君の側からすれば記憶に留まらない程度の浅い関係。
lines.english: —which meant that even if they had met in the past, their relationship had been too shallow to remain in Takashi's memory.

lines.japanese: まあいい、とりあえず無視するわけにもいきません。
lines.english: Well, never mind. I could hardly ignore her now.

lines.japanese: 「どーも」
lines.english: “Hey there.”

lines.japanese: まずは無難に、にこやかな笑顔を返してみました。
lines.english: I started by offering the safest possible response: a friendly smile.

lines.japanese: 「あの……あ、あのう……えと、あの……」
lines.english: “Um... Um, well... I, um...”

lines.japanese: なんだ？　あのあの口篭っててよく聞こえないな。ただでさえ走行音がガタゴトうるさいってのに。
lines.english: What? All that mumbling made her hard to hear, especially with the train already clattering so loudly.

lines.japanese: 「あの、私のこと……分かり、ますか？」
lines.english: “Um, do you... remember me?”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: そう来たか。うん、なるほど。やっぱりその程度の間柄なわけね、君と俺は。
lines.english: So that was where this was going. Yes, I understood. That really was the extent of our relationship.

lines.japanese: 「あー、いや……ごめん、ちょっと思いだせないかも……」
lines.english: “Oh, uh... Sorry. I might not remember...”

lines.japanese: 「で、ですよね」
lines.english: “R-right.”

lines.japanese: がたんごとん、がたんごとん。
lines.english: Clackety-clack, clackety-clack.

lines.japanese: えーと、なんでしょうね、この沈黙は。
lines.english: So... what was this silence supposed to be?

lines.japanese: うーん、単に口下手なお友達ってだけなら、俺のぬるぬる精神を発揮してこっちからガーっと話しかけていくトコなんだけど──
lines.english: Hmm. If she were merely a tongue-tied friend, this would be the moment to unleash my slippery spirit and steamroll her with conversation—

lines.japanese: ──なにぶん今がどういう状況下なのか不透明だからなー。
lines.english: —but the nature of our present situation remained rather unclear.

lines.japanese: 「あの……先輩、ちょっと前まで、もう二本早い電車に乗ってましたよね」
lines.english: “Um... Until recently, you used to catch the train two before this one, didn’t you?”

lines.japanese: 「へ？　ああ……そう、ね……」
lines.english: “Huh? Oh... Yes...”

lines.japanese: そういやタカシ君はそうだっけか。ま、俺は彼よりお寝坊さんですからね。
lines.english: Come to think of it, Takashi had. I was more of a sleepyhead than he was.

lines.japanese: 「三つ後ろの車両で」
lines.english: “Three cars back.”

lines.japanese: 「はあ……そこまでは覚えてないけど」
lines.english: “Oh... I don't remember that much.”

lines.japanese: 「私、覚えてます。いつもそれだったんで」
lines.english: “I do. It was always the same.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、そういうこと。うちら、いつもこんな風に、朝の電車一緒だったんだ？」
lines.english: “Oh, I get it. We used to ride the morning train together like this?”

lines.japanese: こくん。彼女は俯くように頷きました。
lines.english: She nodded with her head lowered.

lines.japanese: その照れくさそうな仕草に、ふと埋もれていた映像が甦って重なりました。これはタカシ君の記憶。彼が朝の通学電車でおぼろげに得ていた情報です。
lines.english: That bashful motion revived a buried image and laid it over the sight before me. This was Takashi's memory: the indistinct information he had picked up on the morning train to school.

lines.japanese: 「ああ！」
lines.english: “Oh!”

lines.japanese: ようやく俺は、自分でも納得のいく答えを掘りだすことが出来ました。
lines.english: At last, I dug up an answer that satisfied even me.

lines.japanese: 「いたいた！　そうだ、思いだした、君よく俺の近くにいた」
lines.english: “You were there! That's right, I remember. You were often near me.”

lines.japanese: そして口にはしませんが、タカシ君はそんなアナタをなんとなく目にして、可愛い子がいるな、なんて眩しい気持ちを抱くこともあったのです。
lines.english: I did not say that Takashi had vaguely noticed her, thought she was cute, and occasionally felt dazzled by her presence.

lines.japanese: 「覚えててくれたんですか……」
lines.english: “You remembered me...”

lines.japanese: いえ、ですから、忘れてたんですって。
lines.english: No. As I said, I had forgotten.

lines.japanese: 「えっと、久しぶりだよねえ！　どう最近？」
lines.english: “Wow, it has been a while! So how have you been?”

lines.japanese: 俺は話を逸らしました。今こそ発揮、ぬるぬるスピリッツ。
lines.english: I changed the subject. Behold: the slippery spirit.

lines.japanese: 「最近は……」
lines.english: “Lately...”

lines.japanese: 「毎朝、羽田先輩を探してました……」
lines.english: “I've looked for you every morning...”

lines.japanese: 「俺？　なんで？」
lines.english: “Me? Why?”

lines.japanese: 「急にいつもの電車で見かけなくなったので……」
lines.english: “Because you suddenly stopped appearing on your usual train...”

lines.japanese: 「はあ」
lines.english: “Oh.”

lines.japanese: 「え、なにが？　俺が急にいなくなると、なんか問題あるの？」
lines.english: “What? Does my sudden disappearance cause some kind of problem?”

lines.japanese: 「あっ、いえ、そう、そんなことはないんですけど……あの、はい、そうなんですけど、そうじゃなくて、問題はないんですけど、あでも私には大問題で……」
lines.english: “Oh, no. It doesn't, exactly... Yes, it does, but it doesn't. There isn't a problem, except it was a very big problem for me...”

lines.japanese: ええーっと？
lines.english: Ummm?

lines.japanese: しどろもどろで要点の見えない話し方をするお嬢さんです。もしこの場に日和子さんでもいたならば、きっと「ハキハキ喋る！」とカミナリが飛んでいたことでしょう。
lines.english: This young lady stammered so badly that her point vanished entirely. Had Hiyoko been here, she surely would have thundered, “Speak clearly!”

lines.japanese: 「ん、アレかな？　なんか俺に用でもあった？」
lines.english: “Hmm. Did you need something from me?”

lines.japanese: 気の毒になってきたので、こちらで会話の進行役を担ってあげることにしました。
lines.english: I was beginning to feel sorry for her, so I took responsibility for moving the conversation along.

lines.japanese: 「あ、はい、あの、一応……そういう、ことに……なるん、ですけど」
lines.english: “Oh, yes, um, I suppose... you could... call it that.”

lines.japanese: 「言いにくそうだね。いいよ、遠慮しないで。どんな用？」
lines.english: “You seem reluctant to say it. Go ahead, don't hold back. What do you need?”

lines.japanese: 「えと、用というか、ですね……あの、用というか……用というか……」
lines.english: “Um, it isn't exactly something I need... I mean, it is... It is...”

lines.japanese: な、なんか、ハァハァして息苦しそうなんすけど。
lines.english: Sh-she was panting as though she could barely breathe.

lines.japanese: そんな緊張するほど言いにくいことなのかな。ひょっとしたらどっかでタカシ君のお人よしっぷりを耳にして、雑用的な力仕事などを頼みたいのかもしれません。
lines.english: Was it truly that difficult to say? Perhaps she had heard somewhere what a soft touch Takashi was and wanted to ask him for some menial physical labor.

lines.japanese: 「はあぁー……」
lines.english: “Haaaa...”

lines.japanese: 深呼吸ですか。
lines.english: A deep breath?

lines.japanese: 「い、言います」
lines.english: “I-I'm going to say it.”

lines.japanese: 「はい、どうぞ」
lines.english: “Go right ahead.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、やっぱりいいです……」
lines.english: “Actually, never mind...”

lines.japanese: 「えええー？　何それ、気になるって。そこまでタメといて、そりゃないでしょ」
lines.english: “What?! Come on, now I'm curious. You can't build it up that much and back out.”

lines.japanese: 「や、あの、ぜんぜん、大したことじゃないです、ほんと、もう、いいです」
lines.english: “N-no, it's nothing, really. It isn't important. Never mind.”

lines.japanese: 「えー、大したことじゃないなら言えるじゃん。なに、死刑宣告？　決闘の申し込み？」
lines.english: “If it isn't important, then you can say it. What, is it a death sentence? A challenge to a duel?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、分かった。告白でしょ～」
lines.english: “Oh, I know. You're confessing your love, right?”

lines.japanese: 「いやあ、もてる男はつらいっすー。なんつってアハハー」
lines.english: “Boy, being irresistible is rough. Just kidding! Ahaha!”

lines.japanese: 「はいはい？」
lines.english: “Yes?”

lines.japanese: 「当たり……です……」
lines.english: “You guessed... right...”

lines.japanese: 「はい」
lines.english: “Right.”

lines.japanese: 「ハイぃぃぃ！？」
lines.english: “RIIIIIGHT?!”

lines.japanese: うそおーん！
lines.english: No waaaay!

lines.japanese: こ、こくは……って、えええっ！　ちょっ、ちょちょちょ、何ソレ聞いてないって！
lines.english: C-confess... What?! Wait, wait, wait! No one told me about this!

lines.japanese: タカシ君、きみ自覚ないだけで実はモテキャラだったのかよオイ！
lines.english: Takashi, were you secretly a ladies' man without even realizing it?!

lines.japanese: 「じょ、冗談キツイなあお嬢さん！　ハハー、あんまりお兄さんをからかうもんじゃないぞー」
lines.english: “Th-that’s quite a joke, young lady! Haha! Don’t tease me like that!”
“What...?”

lines.japanese: ええ。ええ、ええ、分かってますとも。
lines.english: Yes. Yes, yes, I knew.

lines.japanese: こんな可愛い女の子が顔を真っ赤にして打ちあけてるんですから、冗談なんかじゃなく一世一代の大告白だってことぐらいはね、ええ、分かりますとも。
lines.english: A cute girl had turned bright red and laid her feelings bare. I knew perfectly well that this was no joke but the greatest confession of her life.

lines.japanese: 分かってる上でこんな風に茶化すのは、誠意に欠けるリアクションだってこともね、ええ、分かっていますとも。
lines.english: And yes, I also knew that laughing it off this way was a terribly insincere response.

lines.japanese: とは言っても！
lines.english: Even so!

lines.japanese: あまりに突然だし、彼女の想い人はいまの俺じゃないし、いまの俺には心に決めたひとがいるしで、まともな反応なんか出来るわけないじゃないですか！
lines.english: It was too sudden, the person she loved wasn't the person I was now, and I had already given my heart to someone else. How was I supposed to produce a sensible response?!

lines.japanese: 「すみません……」
lines.english: “I'm sorry...”

lines.japanese: タカシ君ファンの後輩さんは、傷付いた様子で口をつぐんでしまいました。
lines.english: Takashi's young admirer fell silent, plainly hurt.

lines.japanese: 適当にあしらわれたこと、それが何を意味するのか察したのかもしれません。
lines.english: Perhaps she understood what my flippant dismissal meant.

lines.japanese: 形の上では、ちょっとお茶目な冗談をハズしてしまっただけ。
lines.english: On the surface, her playful little joke had merely fallen flat.

lines.japanese: しかし実質的には、失恋なのです。
lines.english: In reality, her heart had been broken.

lines.japanese: ごめんなさい。
lines.english: I'm sorry.

lines.japanese: タカシ君じゃなくてごめんなさい。
lines.english: I'm sorry I'm not Takashi.

lines.japanese: 君の好きな彼じゃなくてごめんなさい。
lines.english: I'm sorry I'm not the boy you love.

lines.japanese: ひどく気まずい沈黙に包まれた男女を運んで、列車は薄曇りの街並を突っ切ってゆきます。
lines.english: Carrying a boy and girl wrapped in crushing silence, the train cut through the overcast city.

lines.japanese: はあ……。
lines.english: Sigh...

lines.japanese: この子、どれぐらい前からタカシ君に想いを寄せてたのかなあ。
lines.english: How long had this girl been in love with Takashi?

lines.japanese: ほんの三日四日ぐらいの、ミーハーな憧れレベルってことはないかなあ。
lines.english: Could it have been only three or four days, no more than a passing crush?

lines.japanese: もし何週間も前からだったら気の毒だなあ。
lines.english: If it had been weeks, I felt sorry for her.

lines.japanese: まさかとは思うけど、ひょっとして何ヵ月も前からだったら……つって、さすがにそれはないか。
lines.english: Surely not, but what if it had been months...? No, that seemed impossible.

lines.japanese: ま、でも、あのぐらい可愛い子ならすぐに新しい恋愛が始まって、古い話なんかあっさり忘れてしまうことでしょう。
lines.english: Still, a girl that cute would find a new love soon enough and easily forget this old story.

lines.japanese: とは言っても、やっぱりこっちは気が重い。
lines.english: Even so, my heart remained heavy.

lines.japanese: はぁー……。
lines.english: Siiiiigh...

lines.japanese: 明日から、また乗る車両変えるか……。
lines.english: Maybe I'd change train cars again tomorrow...
